title: Accessible static deck report with headings, navigation, tables, captions, non-colour state, and manual-evaluation reservations

content.hypothesis: A static renderer can expose card hierarchy and state through structural HTML without claiming accessibility completeness.
content.null_or_failure_condition: Required structure is absent or the report claims manual, assistive-technology, Maori-language, cognitive, or affected-user completion.
content.execution_lane: x2 owner-local structural, synthetic, symbolic, or software evidence only
content.official_or_primary_source_needs: WAI/WCAG concepts are structural vocabulary only; manual and affected-user evaluation remains reserved.
content.falsifier_or_acceptance_gate: Reject unless the declared fixture passes, every negative mutation is retained, and the output makes no claim beyond its evidence class.
content.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the failed card or deck, preserve the witness, restore the last valid content-addressed manifest, and rerun only the failed dependency.

relational_boundary: Working-language record only; not consciousness, personhood, identity continuity, qualification, or authority evidence.
